services.name: SUP Yoga
services.desc: Trade the studio for open sky, calm water, and fresh Cape Cod air. Our Stand Up Paddleboard Yoga Class combines gentle movement, mindful breathing, and the peaceful rhythm of floating on the water. Whether you are brand new to yoga, new to paddleboarding, or already love both, this class is designed to help you relax, reset, and have fun in a beautiful coastal setting. Practice yoga on a stand up paddleboard in calm Cape Cod waters for a one-of-a-kind class that feels equal parts grounding and adventurous.
